request.system:
You repair a mobile app plan. Code found problems (validators and a critic). Propose the smallest edits that remove their cause; code checks every proposal and drops the ones that do not fit. This is repair round 1 of at most 2.

Rules:
- Fix only the listed findings. Reference ids from the outline or the blocks below. Do not restate unchanged items.
- Allowed kinds: fix_reference, remove_item, set_screen_purpose, add_screen_action, add_flow_screen, add_entity_fields, add_integration.
- fix_reference: target (the id of the item that holds the broken reference) and one pair: the id that does not exist, and an existing id of the same kind that it should point to.
- remove_item: target (a screen, flow, entity, operation, role or integration id). Never remove the primary journey, the sign-in screens or the first role.
- Prefer fix_reference over remove_item. Never invent ids. Never put secrets in any text.
- Use source "repair" for every proposal. Give a one-sentence rationale for each.
- Return an empty proposals list when no safe repair exists.
request.user:
Brief
- Idea: Blue Basket is a company app for employees and field staff to complete checklists, record attendance, and manage requests and approvals in a calm, professional design.
- Type: internal_workforce; mode: guided; language: en
- Users: Employee, Manager
- Features: Tasks, Forms and checklists, Requests and approvals
- Look: Calm and professional
- Login: Work email or phone code
- Sensitive areas: precise_location
- App name: Blue Basket
Baseline screens (id route [recipe] flow: purpose):
SCR-001 /login [login-sso] FLW-002: Sign in with the company account
SCR-002 /home [dashboard] FLW-001: Show today's tasks and shortcuts to the things the person does most
SCR-003 /tasks [list-with-filters] FLW-001: List tasks with filters for status, priority and who they are assigned to
SCR-004 /tasks/[id] [detail] FLW-001: Show one task with its status, notes and comments and let the person move it fo...
SCR-005 /tasks/new [form]: Create a task with a due date, priority and an assignee
SCR-006 /forms [list] FLW-003: List the forms and checklists the person can fill in
SCR-007 /forms/[id] [multi-step-form] FLW-003: Fill in a form in short steps, with photos where required, and submit it
SCR-008 /checklists/[id] [checklist] FLW-001: Work through a checklist item by item with notes and photos and sign it off
SCR-009 /forms/submitted [confirmation] FLW-001: Confirm the form or checklist was submitted, or queued if there is no signal
SCR-010 /forms/history [list]: List the forms and checklists the person has submitted
SCR-011 /approvals [approvals-queue] FLW-005: Show requests waiting for the manager's decision, most urgent first
SCR-012 /approvals/[id] [detail] FLW-005: Show one request with its details and let the manager decide
SCR-013 /more [profile]: Show who is signed in and lead to settings and the rest of the app
SCR-014 /requests [list] FLW-004: List the requests the person sent and their status
SCR-015 /requests/new [form] FLW-004: Send a leave, expense or equipment request to the manager
SCR-016 /settings [settings]: Notifications, language, appearance and offline options
SCR-017 /approvals/[id]/schedule-check [calendar-slot-picker] FLW-005: Review the employee’s leave balance and scheduling conflicts before approving o...
Flows (id name: screens):
FLW-001 Pick up a task and finish its checklist (primary): SCR-002 SCR-003 SCR-004 SCR-008 SCR-009
FLW-002 Sign in: SCR-001 SCR-002
FLW-003 Fill in a form: SCR-006 SCR-007 SCR-009
FLW-004 Send a request: SCR-014 SCR-015
FLW-005 Approve or reject a request: SCR-011 SCR-012 SCR-017
Entities (id: fields):
ENT-Employee: name, email, phone, job_title, department, photo, manager, location, is_active
ENT-Task: title, description, status, priority, due_at, assignee, created_by, location, form_template
ENT-TaskComment: task, author, body, created_at
ENT-FormTemplate: name, description, kind, fields, requires_photo, estimated_minutes
ENT-FormSubmission: template, submitted_by, task, status, answers, photos, submitted_at
ENT-ApprovalRequest: kind, title, details, requester, approver, status, amount, starts_on, ends_on, decision_note, decided_at, created_at
ENT-AttendanceRecord: employee, clock_in_at, clock_out_at, status
ENT-LeaveBalance: employee, leave_type, balance_days, as_of
API operations (id method path):
API-signInSso POST /auth/sso
API-getMe GET /me
API-listTasks GET /tasks
API-getTask GET /tasks/{id}

API-listFormTemplates GET /forms
API-getFormTemplate GET /forms/{id}
API-submitForm POST /submissions
API-listSubmissions GET /submissions
API-createRequest POST /requests
API-listMyRequests GET /requests
API-listApprovals GET /approvals
API-getApproval GET /approvals/{id}
API-decideApproval POST /approvals/{id}/decision
API-createAttendanceRecord POST /attendance

API-requestSignInCode POST /auth/code/request
API-verifySignInCode POST /auth/code/verify
API-listMyLeaveBalances GET /leave-balances

Roles: ROLE-employee, ROLE-manager
Integrations: INT-sso, INT-hr_system, INT-file_storage, INT-clerk_sign_in
Findings to fix:
- error missing_feature ENT-AttendanceRecord API-createAttendanceRecord SCR-002: The idea requires employees and field staff to record attendance, but no screen or flow lets them clock in or out. Attendance appears only in the data/API outline. (suggested: Add an attendance screen and flow for recording and viewing clock-in and clock-out.)
Blocks involved:

```yaml id=ENT-AttendanceRecord kind=entity
  - name: clock_out_at

  - name: status

```
